scope: OSS host and managed-shard runtime images
summary: Remove the unused node-gyp build tool from production runtime images so fixed-version Undici advisories do not block exact-candidate security qualification.
configuration: The plugin-manager Compose example now names the current 0.1.9 package version; no runtime setting changes.
security: Remove runtime node-gyp rather than suppressing CVE-2026-84961 and related Undici findings in the candidate image scan.
The backend and managed-shard bootstrap images remain subject to the full exact-image vulnerability gate.
documentation: The release notes record the runtime image security remediation and its verification.
rollback: Reverting to the preceding images restores the vulnerable runtime package and requires a separate security decision.
validation: Build and scan the backend and managed-shard bootstrap runtime images with the exact release-candidate Trivy severity gate.
Run the managed-shard bootstrap PostgreSQL smoke and protected candidate readiness pipeline.
